sourceOccurrences.note: FD69 retains arbitrary vertices for the deterministic tail representation, including roots outside the window and zero/impossible thresholds. F0I9 gives simultaneous finite witnesses; SFLE gives monotone event and probability limits. The source exhausts all unordered pairs; the article notes that covering the non-diagonal pairs suffices for graph observables. A finite window is not asserted to be a fixed finite-coordinate support.

sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected exposition with explicit measurable scope
sourceOccurrences.note: 7BMQ gives restriction measurability, induced graph identity, support dependence, monotonicity and finite vertex witnesses without ambient countability. Countability of the domain alone suffices for local-event measurability. The restriction pushforward law is an additional expository cylinder argument. SFLE and 5UJQ supply the countable-exhaustion connection limits; no probability interpretation of unverified measurable ambient events is added.
